package.description: Open-source SSH client with SFTP, remote desktop, port tunneling and DevOps tools.

en-US.author: Alexander Nt.
en-US.description: Open-source SSH client with SFTP, remote desktop, port tunneling and DevOps tools.
en-US.longDescription:
Reach is a cross-platform SSH client with a native interface: SSH terminals in tabs, an SFTP file explorer,
jump hosts, port forwarding, a serial console and remote desktop over RDP and VNC. Sessions and keys live in an
encrypted vault with optional sync. Optional DevOps tools, switched on in Settings, add a database workspace
for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite and Redis, Docker, Podman and Compose, Kubernetes and Helm,
plus Ansible and OpenTofu.
en-US.name: Reach
